from_notes: Su-57 offer by Russia at SPIEF 2026; India left FGFA in 2021 (joined 2007).
x: India joined the Fifth Generation Fighter Aircraft (FGFA) programme with Russia in 2007 and pulled out in 2018 (reported April 2018) over cost, technology-sharing and engine concerns. 2021 (the old key, also printed in Praveen CA-360) is not the year of the exit; 2026 is only the year of Russia's fresh Su-57 offer.
dispute: Praveen CA-360 Jun 2026 p.70 and the old key: 2021. Strictly and in most books: April 2018 (Wikipedia 'Sukhoi/HAL FGFA'; The Diplomat, April 2018).
source: Web search (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sukhoi/HAL_FGFA; thediplomat.com/2018/04 'India pulls out of'; key.aero 'India withdraws from fifth generation fighter' – 20 April 2018; search summaries)
evidence: Praveen CA-360 Jun 2026 magazine p.70 ('joined the FGFA programme with Russia in 2007 but withdrew in 2021') – contradicted by the 2018 reports
